svg.title: Booking flow animation
svg.desc: A passenger ticket is validated, checked against its class capacity, and then enqueued at the rear of either the confirmed queue or the FIFO waiting queue.

g.text: if (q->rear) q->rear->next = p; // link behind old rear
q->rear = p; // move the rear pointer
